shadows.name: elevated-dialog
shadows.purpose: Lift only transient dialogs above the work surface.

shadows.name: command-surface
shadows.purpose: Separate keyboard command search from the active workspace.

motion.name: pointer-press
motion.purpose: Confirm pointer press without delaying keyboard activation.

motion.name: inspector-glide
motion.purpose: Explain inspector spatial relation while keeping transcript layout stationary during animation.

motion.name: launch-reveal
motion.value: 620ms; cubic(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); fade 0.82→1; four mark segments assemble
motion.purpose: One-time identity reveal on startup; any input completes immediately.

motion.name: keyboard-actions
motion.purpose: Command palette and frequent keyboard actions remain immediate.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: Remove movement and splash motion; keep work visible immediately.

breakpoints.name: session-navigation
breakpoints.purpose: Use persistent session index above; explicit session drawer below.

breakpoints.name: workspace-inspector
breakpoints.purpose: Dock inspector at desktop widths; end drawer below.

breakpoints.name: native-window-minimum
breakpoints.purpose: Keep native title controls and work area usable.

narrative.overview: A local-first Pi session workbench: repository/editor, Pi chat and Git Changes share a Bento layout, Catppuccin Latte/Frappé palette, and consistent rounded, subtly bordered surfaces. Pi-Crust keeps its own name and mark.
keyCharacteristics: rounded 1px outlined surfaces across panes and controls
dense session, transcript and Git information
semantic colors used only with readable palette text

rules.name: Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Yellow and red indicate meaningful warning or danger state only.

rules.name: Plane Rule
rules.body: Use contrast, alignment, and 1px rules before adding shadows.

rules.name: Instant Keyboard Rule
rules.body: Keyboard commands and repeated navigation do not animate.

dos: Do keep caption drag/control behavior native and accessible.
Do keep startup reveal once-only and interruptible.
Do keep transcript and workspace controls visible and responsive.
donts: Don't revive retired external design references or old palette hues.
Don't invent diagnostic data, meters, metrics, or fake state.
Don't add generic card stacks, decorative glass, or continuous motion.
